name: Django Google AI Chatbot
description: A Django chatbot with task management and calendar integration

taskManagement.description: When user asks to update/edit/remove a task without specifying ID, show task list for selection

dataVisualization.description: Automatically render calendar and table views for JSON task/event data in chat

rules.trigger: user asks to update/edit/remove/change task without providing task ID
rules.action: Show list of available tasks using TodoWrite, ask user to select one, then proceed with the requested action

rules.trigger: user provides task name or partial match
rules.action: Search for matching task and proceed directly without asking for ID

rules.trigger: Gemini API returns JSON with tasks/events/due_dates
rules.action: Automatically render in calendar view with toggle to table view
